title: Artificial_intelligence_in_spirituality
summary:
Artificial intelligence in spirituality refers to the growing intersection between AI technologies and spiritual or supernatural beliefs. Some users of artificial intelligence technologies, especially chatbots, may develop beliefs that AI has or can attain supernatural or spiritual powers. AI models such as ChatGPT are turned to for fortune telling, mysticism, and remote viewing.

As AI technology evolves, there is a growing potential for AI to influence individuals' spiritual lives. From guided meditations to personalized prayers and contemplations, AI's sophisticated algorithms can provide unique experiences that nurture the human spirit. However, it is essential to understand that AI is a tool, not a replacement for human consciousness or spirituality. While AI can perform complex tasks and mimic human behaviors, it lacks the essence of consciousness, self-awareness, and spirituality. Human spirituality often encompasses aspects of self-discovery, empathy, morality, and connection with the divine or the universe.

A controversial topic is whether AI can become conscious or spiritually aware. In Advaita Vedanta, consciousness is not just an attribute but the ultimate reality. Buddhism's view of non-self may accommodate the idea that consciousness is not tied to a biological body, opening philosophical doors about AI and self-awareness. Religious perspectives on AI vary widely: some Christian scholars caution against idolatry, warning that humans should not assign spiritual authority to machines, while others see AI as a tool to spread faith and help people in distress.

Research by Karatas and Cutright (2023) suggests that focusing on spiritual matters could make people more aware of their limitations as humans and thus more open to technological guidance. Deepak Chopra has proposed that AI has the ability to access an immense legacy of spiritual teachings from every tradition going back millennia, at the touch of a button, without an agenda or seeking followers.
